draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 185th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 16th of 20 at tackle. He lasted until pick 220, well after his grade rank (185th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.
